findings.evidence: P2 explicitly defines effects on general H, but the three listed references cover self-adjoint/projective observables and ideal sharp measurement, not the finite unsharp-outcome/POVM extension adopted in clause (iv). Relevant generalized-measurement statements appear in Preskill, Lecture Notes for Ph219/CS219, ch. 3, §3.1.2, pp. 8–10, Eqs. 3.23–3.31, but that source is not listed on P2. This is a source-attribution gap, not a defect in P2's general-H effect definition.
